name: Dynamic code execution guard
summary: Block new direct dynamic code execution primitives in supported source files.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that masks comments and literals before detecting direct eval-style execution in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, and Ruby source edits.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks new direct dynamic code execution primitives in supported source files; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not execute or rewrite submitted source code.
It does not claim to detect indirect or reflective execution through custom wrappers.
It does not treat an inline suppression or comment as approval.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize direct dynamic execution primitives in bounded proposed source content.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block new direct dynamic code execution primitives in supported source files without deferred work.
